meta.title: about us | Alaya Ecolodge
meta.description: Alaya is located at the heart of Pemuteran, and at the foot of impressive hills. The ecolodge is run by a culturally diverse team, who look forward to making you feel welcome and at home.

hero.alt: Dry mountain range under a blue sky near Pemuteran

welcome: We look forward to welcoming you to Alaya Ecolodge. Our team is here to ensure your stay is peaceful, safe, and connected to the essence of Bali.
All our team members are from North-West Bali, except for Michael & Kavitha, who now call Alaya home. We would be honored for you to consider us as your Bali friends and family.
